traits.name: Wolf Empathy
traits.text: (divination, primal); The werewolf can communicate with lupines.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: battle axe, composite shortbow (20 arrows), studded leather armor;

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate, polymorph, primal, transmutation); Human with fist +11 for 1d4+8 (1d4+8) bludgeoning, or wolf with Speed 40 feet and jaws with Knockdown.

traits.name: Moon Frenzy
traits.text: (polymorph, primal, transmutation); When a full moon appears in the night sky, the werewolf must enter hybrid form, can't Change Shape thereafter, becomes one size larger, increases its reach by 5 feet, and increases the damage of its jaws by 2. When the moon sets or the sun rises, the werewolf returns to humanoid form and is fatigued for 2d4 (2d4) hours.

traits.name: Pack Attack
traits.text: The werewolf's Strikes deal 1d6 (1d6) extra damage to creatures within reach of at least two of the werewolf's allies.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +11 Damage 1d8+8 (1d8+8) piercing plus curse of the werewolf

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ composite shortbow +9 (deadly 1d10, range increment 60 feet, reload 0); Damage 1d6+4 (1d6+4) piercing
